verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Twilio versions at least some of its APIs: the docs reference the 'v2 Regulatory Compliance (RC) REST APIs'. A changelog with an RSS feed is adjacent communication, not a deprecation policy. No evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or a versioning scheme across the API surface. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, deprecation/sunset timelines and notice periods, API-wide versioning scheme documentation, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: shows how to create a Regulatory Bundle with the v2 Regulatory Compliance (RC) REST APIs.
